test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 30 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: TakeMe2S pace (TM2Space), an innovative space technology firm, is based in which city of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hyderabad**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **TakeMe2Space (TM2Space)** is an **innovative space technology firm** based in **Hyderabad, India**.
 
• Hyderabad has emerged as a hub for **space technology**, **startups**, and **research and development** in India.
 
• TakeMe2Space specializes in developing **advanced space technology** and contributes to **India's space missions**.
 
• Hyderabad is home to several prominent organizations like **ISRO's National Remote Sensing Centre (NRSC)** and the **Research Centre Imarat (RCI)**, which supports the growth of space-related industries.
 
• The city provides a robust ecosystem for **space startups** with access to **skilled workforce, infrastructure, and government initiatives.**
 
• TakeMe2Space also collaborates with other **space agencies** and organizations to promote **satellite development, space exploration, and innovation.**
 
• Hyderabad's strategic focus on **technology** and **innovation** makes it a preferred location for companies like TakeMe2Space.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **New Delhi**__

 __
 
• **New Delhi** is the capital of India and a major hub for **policy-making** and **administration**.
 
• It is home to **ISRO's headquarters** and other national-level institutions that contribute to India's space programs.
 
• While New Delhi is critical for policy and governance, it is not the base of TakeMe2Space.
 
 
 
• **Chennai**__
 __
 
• **Chennai** is a key city in southern India and houses the **ISRO Propulsion Complex (IPRC)**, which plays a vital role in space propulsion systems.
 
• It has a growing technology sector but is not the location for TakeMe2Space.
 
 
 
• **Kolkata**__
 
 
• **Kolkata**, located in eastern India, is known for its rich history and culture but is not a prominent hub for **space technology startups**.
 
• While it has institutions contributing to science and technology, it is not the base for TakeMe2Space.
